intro: Understand short messages about a change of plan, a time or a task. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Salut, le bus a du retard et j'arriverai vers dix-huit heures.
frases.alumno: Hi, the bus is late and I will arrive around six o'clock.

frases.estudio: Attends-moi devant le cinéma, je t'envoie un message en arrivant.
frases.alumno: Wait for me in front of the cinema; I'll send you a message when I arrive.

frases.estudio: La séance commence à dix-huit heures trente, alors nous avons le temps.
frases.alumno: The screening starts at half past six, so we have time.

frases.estudio: Préviens aussi Lina parce qu'elle vient directement du travail.
frases.alumno: Let Lina know too, because she is coming straight from work.

texto: Understand short messages about a change of plan, a time or a task. First look for names, days, places and figures: in notices and forms these are usually easy to find.
Point to note: « Parce que » gives a cause and « alors » introduces a consequence in an informal message. In this passage, «message» means «message».
